panels.title: Settlement fee per contract by application month (BRL unless noted)
panels.description: Settlement fee per contract from the B3 Fee Variables file (BVBG.024.01, `b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse` parquet), plotted as a step line at each publication's validity start date. One series per asset and market; the currency is appended only when it is not BRL. Log scale; filtered by the segment, market and asset variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  concat_ws(' · ', asset, 'mkt ' || market, CASE WHEN settlement_fee_ccy <> 'BRL' THEN settlement_fee_ccy END) AS series,
  settlement_fee::DOUBLE AS settlement_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE settlement_fee IS NOT NULL
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('__all' IN ($segment) OR segment IN ($segment))
  AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market IN ($market))
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Conversion rates applied, by conversion instrument (sample assets)
panels.description: Currency/index conversion rate B3 applies to fee calculations, one step line per conversion instrument ID (highest rate per validity start date). Each series label lists up to 4 of the assets that use that instrument. Log scale; from the Fee Variables parquet, filtered by the segment, market and asset variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE conversion_instrument_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
    AND ('__all' IN ($segment) OR segment IN ($segment))
    AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market IN ($market))
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
),
labels AS (
  SELECT conversion_instrument_id,
    conversion_instrument_id::VARCHAR || ' (' || array_to_string(list_sort(list(DISTINCT asset))[1:4], ', ')
      || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT asset) > 4 THEN ', …' ELSE '' END || ')' AS series
  FROM d
  GROUP BY conversion_instrument_id
)
SELECT d.valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  labels.series,
  max(d.conversion_rate)::DOUBLE AS conversion_rate
FROM d
JOIN labels USING (conversion_instrument_id)
GROUP BY time, labels.series
ORDER BY time, labels.series

panels.title: Current fee variables (latest publication in range)
panels.description: All fee variables per segment, market and asset from the most recent Fee Variables report in the time range: settlement fee, holding fee reduction factor and daily value (with currencies), physical-delivery rate, conversion instrument/rate and the validity window. The latest report is picked before the segment, market and asset filters are applied, so an asset missing from that report shows no row.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT asset, segment, market,
  settlement_fee::DOUBLE AS settlement_fee, settlement_fee_ccy,
  holding_reduction_factor::DOUBLE AS holding_reduction_factor,
  holding_daily_value::DOUBLE AS holding_daily_value, holding_daily_value_ccy,
  physical_delivery_rate::DOUBLE AS physical_delivery_rate,
  conversion_instrument_id, conversion_ref_dt,
  conversion_rate::DOUBLE AS conversion_rate,
  report_dt, valid_from, valid_to
FROM d
WHERE report_dt = (SELECT max(report_dt) FROM d)
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('__all' IN ($segment) OR segment IN ($segment))
  AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market IN ($market))
ORDER BY segment, market, asset

panels.title: Fee variable changes vs previous publication
panels.description: Every change in settlement fee, holding reduction factor, holding daily value or physical-delivery rate compared with the previous publication for the same segment, market and asset, with the percent change. Changes are listed if their validity start is in the time range (the previous value may come from before it); newest first, capped at 500 rows, filtered by the segment, market and asset variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH u AS (
  UNPIVOT (
    SELECT valid_from, segment, market, asset,
      settlement_fee, holding_reduction_factor, holding_daily_value, physical_delivery_rate
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
      AND ('__all' IN ($segment) OR segment IN ($segment))
      AND ('__all' IN ($market) OR market IN ($market))
  )
  ON settlement_fee, holding_reduction_factor, holding_daily_value, physical_delivery_rate
  INTO NAME fee_variable VALUE amount
),
d AS (
  SELECT *,
    lag(amount) OVER (
      PARTITION BY segment, market, asset, fee_variable
      ORDER BY valid_from
    ) AS prev_amount
  FROM u
)
SELECT valid_from, asset, market, fee_variable,
  prev_amount::DOUBLE AS previous_value,
  amount::DOUBLE AS current_value,
  (amount / nullif(prev_amount, 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS change_pct
FROM d
WHERE prev_amount IS NOT NULL
  AND amount <> prev_amount
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY valid_from DESC, fee_variable, abs(amount - prev_amount) DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Highest BRL settlement fees per contract (latest publication in range)
panels.description: Top 15 asset/market pairs by settlement fee per contract (BRL) in the most recent Fee Variables report in the time range. Fees in other currencies are excluded. Unfiltered top-N: ignores the segment, market and asset variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT asset || ' (mkt ' || market || ')' AS instrument,
  settlement_fee::DOUBLE AS settlement_fee
FROM d
WHERE report_dt = (SELECT max(report_dt) FROM d)
  AND settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL'
ORDER BY settlement_fee DESC
LIMIT 15
